name: loopback-direct-diagnostic
command: import {serveHosted} from "@runeditrun/rer/internal/cli/hosted-output.mjs"; const h=await serveHosted(process.cwd(),{declaration:"deploy.json"}); try {for(const headers of [{},{host:"rer-hosted-check.invalid"},{host:"rer-hosted-check.invalid",accept:"text/css,*/*;q=0.1","accept-encoding":"gzip, deflate, br, zstd","sec-fetch-mode":"no-cors","sec-fetch-dest":"style",referer:"https://rer-hosted-check.invalid/"}]){const r=await h.fetch("rer-theme.css",{headers,signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000)}); console.log(JSON.stringify({headerNames:Object.keys(headers),status:r.status,bytes:(await r.arrayBuffer()).byteLength}));}}finally{await h.close();}
